description: `string` declares a string variable (Verilog-AMS 2.4), which this simulator does not implement: there is no string value type in its IR. Approximating it, for example as a number, would print or compare the wrong thing. Until 2.33.0 this was reported as a missing `string` discipline.
actions: Write the text directly where it is used, e.g. `$strobe("label: %g", x);`.
To choose between texts, choose between whole statements: `if (mode == 1) $strobe("fast"); else $strobe("slow");`.
